import ctypes

# Load libraries in correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Access the version string
gsl_version_str = ctypes.c_char_p.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_version").value.decode('utf-8')

def assert_test():
    # Test 1: Version string is not empty
    assert len(gsl_version_str) > 0, "Version string must not be empty"
    
    # Test 2: Version string contains at least one dot (e.g., '2.7')
    assert '.' in gsl_version_str, "Version must contain a dot separator"
    
    # Test 3: Version string starts with a digit (major version)
    assert gsl_version_str[0].isdigit(), "Major version must be a digit"
    
    # Test 4: Version string has expected format (digits and dots)
    parts = gsl_version_str.split('.')
    assert all(part.isdigit() for part in parts), "All version parts must be digits"
    
    # Test 5: Return value is a string
    assert isinstance(gsl_version_str, str), "Return type must be string"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
    print(f"GSL version: {gsl_version_str}")
